name: bobcutpaste
title: Cut and Paste Contents
author: Arfian Adam
description:
Cut and paste (Ctrl+X) keeps building contents: items in chests, furnaces, assemblers, turrets and wagons, fluid in tanks, pipes and machines, the item in an inserter's hand and the items on belts all end up in the pasted copy instead of going off with the robots.

Modules are left to the blueprint as usual.
